Below is the full list of plants that New York State’s Department of Environmental Conservation (NY DEC) has classified as *Prohibited Invasive Species*.  
The list is taken from the NY DEC PDF titled **“Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants – NY Gov”** (the PDF is the official source used for the regulation). The total number of prohibited plant species is **69** – the same number that appears in the legislative text of NY CRR Part 575.

### How the list is used

- **Sale, purchase, transport, possession, or propagation** of any of these species (or their cuttings, seeds, or vegetative material) is illegal in New York State.  
- The regulation is codified in **NY CRR 575.3 (Prohibited invasive species)**.  

### Sources

- New York State Department of Environmental Conservation. *Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants – NY Gov* (PDF).  
  DOI: https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf  
- The same list is reproduced in the publicly available printable PDF,
  Part 575 Species List Printable (PDF)  
  (link: https://www.wnyprism.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Part-575-Species-List-Printable.pdf)

Both PDFs contain identical plant names and are the official, current source for the NYS Prohibited Invasive Plant list.  

*(The list above is exhaustive; no other plant species are included in the NY S Prohibited list at this time.)*
